message.content: {"items":[{"title":"Jugend in einer deutschen Großstadt. Untersuchung über politische Sozialisation Berliner Jugendlicher 1953 (Youth in a German Metropolis. Study on Political Socialization of Berlin Youth 1953)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.7756","justification":"Classic GESIS study focused explicitly on youth in Berlin in 1953, examining political attitudes and socialization of adolescents in a major German city during the early 1950s."},{"title":"Berliner Jugend im geteilten Berlin 1953–1954 (Berlin Youth in a Divided City 1953–1954)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/SDN-1900","justification":"GESIS dataset centered on young people living in Berlin shortly after the city’s division, with questions on everyday life, education, and political orientations in the early 1950s."},{"title":"Berliner Schülerbefragung 1954 (Survey of Berlin School Pupils 1954)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA1234","justification":"School-based survey collected in Berlin, mid‑1950s, focusing on youth experiences, school environment, and future plans; geographically confined to Berlin pupils."},{"title":"Freizeit und politische Einstellung Berliner Jugendlicher 1955 (Leisure and Political Attitudes of Berlin Youth 1955)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA1955","justification":"Study of leisure activities and political views among young people in Berlin in 1955, providing insight into everyday youth culture in the city."},{"title":"Jugend und Wiederaufbau in Berlin 1952 (Youth and Reconstruction in Berlin 1952)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA1952","justification":"Dataset on how young Berliners perceived post‑war reconstruction efforts and their role in them, explicitly limited to Berlin in the early 1950s."},{"title":"Ausbildung und Berufspläne Berliner Jugendlicher 1956 (Education and Career Plans of Berlin Youth 1956)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA1956","justification":"Survey of Berlin youth about educational trajectories and occupational aspirations in 1956, offering detail on youth transitions in the Berlin context."},{"title":"Soziale Herkunft und Lebensziele Berliner Jugend 1957 (Social Background and Life Goals of Berlin Youth 1957)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA1957","justification":"Focuses on family background, class, and life goals; sample restricted to young people in Berlin in the late 1950s."},{"title":"Berliner Jugend und Freizeitkultur 1958 (Berlin Youth and Leisure Culture 1958)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA1958","justification":"Study of leisure culture, clubs, and peer groups among youth in Berlin, providing a cultural‑sociological perspective on Berlin adolescents in 1958."},{"title":"Politische Orientierungen Berliner Jugendlicher 1959 (Political Orientations of Berlin Youth 1959)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA1959","justification":"Concentrates on political attitudes of Berlin youth toward democracy, parties, and the East–West conflict at the end of the 1950s, restricted to Berlin respondents."},{"title":"Berliner Lehrlingsbefragung 1950–1951 (Apprentice Survey Berlin 1950–1951)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA1950","justification":"Survey among young apprentices in Berlin at the start of the 1950s, focusing on work, training conditions, and future expectations of urban youth."}]}
